# Ironstone Masonry

> Ironstone Masonry is an owner-operated masonry and outdoor construction contractor with 15+ years of experience. It builds and repairs patios, walkways, retaining walls, stonework, concrete, and exterior masonry for homeowners and commercial property owners in Brewster, NY and nearby communities in Connecticut (Fairfield County) and New York (Westchester County). Free, no-obligation estimates are offered on every project.

## Services
- [Masonry Contractor in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/masonry.html): Ironstone Masonry is an owner-operated masonry contractor building and repairing brick, concrete block and natural stone structures for homeowners and commercial property owners in Brewster, NY and nearby Connecticut and New York towns.
- [Patio Installation in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/patios.html): Ironstone Masonry designs and builds custom paver, natural stone and concrete patios that extend your living space and stand up to Hudson Valley and Fairfield County winters.
- [Walkway Installation in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/walkways.html): Ironstone Masonry builds stone, brick and paver walkways, steps and landings that are safe underfoot, easy to maintain and a strong match for your home.
- [Retaining Wall Contractor in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/retaining-walls.html): Ironstone Masonry builds and rebuilds retaining walls in natural stone and segmental block, engineered for drainage, erosion control and long-term stability on sloped properties.
- [Concrete Contractor in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/concrete-work.html): Ironstone Masonry forms, pours and finishes concrete driveways, slabs, steps and footings, and repairs or resurfaces worn concrete, for properties in Brewster, NY and nearby Connecticut and New York towns.
- [Natural Stonework & Stone Veneer in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/stonework.html): Ironstone Masonry hand-fits natural stone veneer, walls, fireplaces, columns and accents, adding texture, character and lasting value to homes in Brewster, NY and nearby Connecticut and New York towns.
- [Outdoor Improvements & Living Spaces in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/outdoor-improvements.html): Ironstone Masonry adds fire pits, seating walls, outdoor kitchens, steps and finishing touches that make your outdoor space more comfortable, functional and enjoyable.
- [Masonry Repair & Tuckpointing in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/exterior-repairs.html): Ironstone Masonry repairs cracked, crumbling and damaged brick, stone, mortar and concrete, then seals and weatherproofs the work so the repair lasts.
- [Outdoor Space Renovations in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/outdoor-renovations.html): Ironstone Masonry renovates tired outdoor spaces from start to finish, tearing out what is failing and rebuilding patios, walkways, walls and steps into one cohesive design.
- [Custom Masonry & Exterior Projects in Brewster, NY](https://www.ironstonemasonryllc.com/other-projects.html): Have a masonry or outdoor construction idea that does not fit a category? Ironstone Masonry builds custom features and mixed-material projects for properties in Brewster, NY and nearby Connecticut and New York towns.
